title: Hopes and Plans
synopsis:
Zhou Wu arrives at the office at 10:00 am for an interview with Zhong Ming and Elsie.
This lesson is Business Course 2, Unit 1-L2. In this lesson, you will learn what happens during an interview for a high-level sales representative at a trading company.

fullText.simplified:
希望和打算

钟明：周小姐，你好，我是业务三部的钟明，这位是我的同事爱西。
周舞：钟先生，爱西小姐，你们好。
钟明：我看了你的简历，你大学毕业后就在TG公司工作了，你在那儿工作了六年，去年六月离开，现在在找新工作。TG是个好公司，你在那儿也做得很不错，我能问一下，你为什么离开吗？
周舞：我是因为自己的原因离开TG公司的。
钟明：对不起，我能问一下，是什么原因吗？
周舞：我爸妈在北方开了一个小工厂，很多年了，他们老了，想让我回北方帮他们。现在这个小工厂已经关了，我就回深圳了。
钟明：谢谢，我明白了。你对我们公司了解吗？有什么问题想问我吗？
周舞：非常了解，没有问题。
钟明：很好，你对以后的工作有什么希望和打算吗？
周舞：我希望我以前的工作经验能帮到Dream Asia，同时自己也在Dream Asia有更好的发展。
钟明：你以前的工作很棒，我们经理已经看过你的简历了，他对你很满意。我们对你没有问题，今天的面试其实是想早点儿认识你。
周舞：谢谢。
钟明：爱西，你有问题想问周小姐吗？
爱西：有。周小姐，TG公司也是贸易公司，你在那儿工作了六年，你觉得业务员的工作中最重要的东西是什么呢？
周舞：时间、样品和邮件。
爱西：谢谢你，我没有问题了。
钟明：周小姐，如果面试成功，你最快什么时候能来公司上班呢？
周舞：我已经准备好了，下个星期一就可以开始新工作。
钟明：太好了，我们会在星期五前告诉你结果。
周舞：好的，谢谢。

周舞：我爸媽在北方開了一個小工廠，很多年了，他們老了，想讓我回北方幫他們。現在這個小工廠已經關了，我就回深圳了。

周舞：好的，謝謝。

sentence_translations: Hopes and Plans
Zhong Ming: Hello, Ms. Zhou. I am Zhong Ming from the 3rd Sales Department. This is my colleague Elsie.
Zhou Wu: Hello, Mr. Zhou and Ms. Elsie.
Zhong Ming: I looked at your resume. You started working at TG right after graduating from college.
You worked there for six years and left in July of last year. You are currently looking for a new job.
TG is a good company, and you did very well there. May I ask why you left?
Zhou Wu: I left TG due to personal reasons.
Zhong Ming: I’m sorry, may I ask what reason?
Zhou Wu: My parents opened a small factory in the north many years ago.
They were getting old and wanted me to go back to the north to help them.
Now that the small factory has closed, I have come back to Shenzhen.
Zhong Ming: Thank you, I understand now.
Do you know about our company? Do you have any questions you would like to ask me?
Zhou Wu: I know a lot about it. I don’t have any questions.
Zhong Ming: Very good. What are your hopes and plans for your future work?
Zhou Wu: I hope my past work experience can benefit Dream Asia, and at the same time, I can also develop myself better at Dream Asia.
Zhong Ming: Your previous job was excellent.
Our manager has already looked at your resume, and he is very satisfied with you.
We don’t have any questions for you. Today’s interview was actually because we wanted to get to know you sooner.
Zhou Wu: Thank you.
Zhong Ming: Elsie, do you have any questions for Ms. Zhou?
Elsie: Yes. Ms. Zhou, TG is also a trading company.
You worked there for six years. What do you think are the most important things in a salesperson’s job?
Zhou Wu: Time, samples, and emails.
Elsie: Thank you, I have no more questions.
Zhong Ming: Ms. Zhou, if the interview is successful, what is the soonest you can come to work at the company?
Zhou Wu: I am ready. I can start the new job next Monday.
Zhong Ming: Great, we’ll let you know the outcome by Friday.
Zhou Wu: Okay, thank you.
